body.x: RNWARE (CEO Kim Yeong-gyu, www.anysync.co.kr) showcased its smart wireless image transmission device “ANYSYNC Full HD” in the joint pavilion of the Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC)at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).

ANYSYNC is a wireless device that can transmit in real time images and audio of various devices -- including smartphones, tablets, PCs, and camcorders -- to external output devices, such as TVs and beam projectors.

Those who work at schools and companies can send images on a screen of a PC or a smart device to a larger screen, and share them simultaneously with others. Unlike other existing devices, this product is wireless, giving a clean feel to any presentation room.

Anyone can easily use this product, as it automatically recognizes two different devices when a transmitter and a receiver are connected to each device. This is done without the need of additional apps, software, and wireless APs. When the button is pushed on the receiver, screens can be switched as well. One receiver can be connected to up to 254 transmitters.

The product can implement real time mirroring, which transmits entire contents on the screen of a smart device. It is also compatible with various OS and other devices via the HDMI port. It will be officially launched in foreign markets in January, and in the domestic market in March.
RNWARE CEO Kim Yeong-gyu said: “Smartphones have spurred the mobile market, and now, there are various wireless image transmission devices. But most of them are cheap products.”
“We will dominate the foreign smart and school markets by using ANYSYNC products and their world-class technology.”

RNWARE is a venture firm that specializes in embedded image wireless communication, all based on touch sensor and image transmission technologies. Targeting the smart education and meeting markets, the company has launched the ANYSYNC product line. It exports its products not only to domestic companies and educational institutes, but also to Europe, Indonesia, Japan, and the Middle East.

MTCC prepared the joint pavilion at this exhibition and supported related domestic companies’ participation in CES 2016, promoting the next-generation embedded system industry. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold ‘CES 2016 Review Conference’ in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
